notes: Event date: Schramm, OKW war diary (KTB 1944, western theater, p. 366), entry of 4 September: the First Parachute Army receives the Fallschirmjäger divisions 3, 5 and 6: "Div.en 3, 5 und 6" ... Location approximate: the midpoint of Antwerp and Maastricht stands for the canal front. Location support fallback: fallback point only; the source gives no place for the division.
